roles.heroLead: Sixty-year-old Mercer Island ramblers hide their condition under the original 4×4 tile — and tile was never the waterproof layer anyway; the membrane behind it is. We open the bath, tell you honestly what the subfloor says, build the assembly, flood-test it for 24 hours with photos, and only then set tile.

roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost on Mercer Island, WA?
roles.costP1: On Mercer Island, tile installation totals roughly $14–$26 per square foot installed — tile, setting materials, substrate prep and labor, with labor from $11/sq ft. A standard tub-shower surround runs $3,200–$6,800; a full bathroom with floor, shower and niche usually finishes between $6,500 and $14,000. In a mid-century house the swing lives in substrate prep — we price it after looking, not by surprise.
roles.costP2: Counterintuitive but true: the tile's shape moves your bill more than its price. A $4 mosaic sheet can cost more to install than $12 large-format porcelain, because labor is spent on cuts and grout lines — the tile invoice itself is almost beside the point.
roles.costNote: Mercer Island ranges, August 2026 — tile plus materials plus labor. The written quote from the free on-site visit is the number that binds.
roles.layersLead: Seven layers from joists to grout. Every failed shower we open on the Island is missing at least one — nearly always the membrane, cut once to save a few hundred dollars, opened later at a five-figure cost.
roles.whyP1: A leak gives no warning. Water slips past grout, soaks into the substrate, and in a daylight rambler shows up a floor below — a ceiling stain in the rec room, a soft spot by the hallway — two years after the fact. The repair by then is framing, subfloor, drywall and the whole tile job again.
roles.whyP2: Waterproofing is about a tenth of what a shower costs. In a 1965 house it's also the difference between a remodel and a future excavation.

roles.faqH2: Tile installation FAQ — Mercer Island, WA
roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost on Mercer Island, WA?
roles.faqA1: Roughly $14 to $26 per square foot installed on Mercer Island, once tile, setting materials, substrate prep and labor are summed — labor starts at $11 per square foot by itself. A tub-shower surround runs $3,200 to $6,800; a full bathroom with floor, shower and niche typically totals $6,500 to $14,000. Format is the multiplier people miss: mosaic sheets and large-format tile each take considerably more labor per square foot than standard 12×12.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower on Mercer Island?
roles.faqA2: Figure $3,200 to $6,800 for a standard alcove shower on Mercer Island, including demolition, bonded waterproofing, the pre-sloped pan or base, tile, a niche and grout. Curbless entries, benches, steam and full-height stone push higher — as does structural correction if the joists under a 1960s bath have been wet before. Waterproofing is about a tenth of the cost and eliminates the failure mode that costs tens of thousands.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Yes — it's the point of the job. Every shower gets a bonded waterproofing system: pre-sloped base, membrane up the walls, sealed corners, seams and penetrations, then a 24-hour flood test that we document with photographs before setting any tile. Grout and tile pass water; only the membrane keeps it out of framing that, on this island, has often stayed dry for sixty years and should continue to.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Plan on four to six working days for a Mercer Island bathroom: demolition and dust control, then substrate and waterproofing with the 24-hour flood test, one to two days of tile setting, and a closing day of grout, silicone and trim. The grout cures 24 hours before first use. If demolition reveals subfloor repairs, we tell you the same day with a price, not at the end.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Porcelain for every floor and wet area: under 0.5% water absorption, denser and more chip-resistant than ceramic. Ceramic is a fair economy for walls and backsplashes. In mid-century Island baths we specify porcelain underfoot and in shower floors without exception, and let ceramic or glass argue for wall space.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes. Electric radiant mat under tile adds about $11 to $16 per square foot installed, thermostat included — and over a daylight basement or crawlspace it's the cheapest fix for a cold mid-century floor. It goes over an uncoupling membrane, is resistance-checked before and after tile, and takes its own dedicated circuit. Worth doing only while the floor is open.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: Usually, and on the Island especially. Removal and haul-away run about $3.50 per square foot, and demolition is the only honest look at a 60-year-old subfloor — rot, movement, past leaks — plus the only way to hold floor height at doorways. Tiling over existing tile on a flat, sound, bonded floor is possible, but it buries exactly the evidence we want to see.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost on Mercer Island?
roles.faqA8: A standard 30 square foot kitchen backsplash on Mercer Island installs for $1,100 to $2,200, outlet cuts, edge trim and color-matched grout included. Herringbone, mosaic sheets, framed range details and slab-look porcelain occupy the top of the range — you're buying layout and cutting hours, not costlier tile.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Often, and we'll say when. Repair and regrout start at $8 per square foot — appropriate for stained or crumbling grout, a few cracked tiles from an impact, or corners needing silicone in place of grout. Hollow-sounding tile, a pattern of loosening, or a wall that flexes means the substrate is finished, and repairs only rent you time. We diagnose first, quote second.
roles.faqQ10: Which Mercer Island neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: The whole Island — Town Center, First Hill, East Seattle, Roanoke, Mercerdale, Mercerwood, Barnabie Point, Faben Point, Proctor Landing and The Lakes, North End to South End — plus Enatai, Beaux Arts Village, Newport Shores, Bellevue and Seattle over the bridges.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: Our tile work carries a 2-year workmanship warranty — twice our carpet term, because tile defects appear in year two, not week two. When we install a manufacturer's complete bonded waterproofing assembly their system warranty applies too, and the photographs of your membrane and flood test are kept on record — useful engineering history if the house ever changes owners.
